sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: Quality Checks row 25 (check 24), Internal Quality Checks row 25, Deterministic Checks rows for check-rubric-schema.py, check-scoring-policy.py, check-verifier-contract.py
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r3/task/tests/scored/functional/prompt.md (restart section), all five prompt.md placeholders, tests/app_context.md headings
evidence: Static structure verified by reading and by parsing every file with tomllib (in memory, nothing written to the snapshot). tests/scoring.toml:1-11 has exactly [gates] render=0.0, constraints=0.0; [weights] functional=0.6, polish=0.2, visual=0.2 (sum 1.0); [floors] functional=0.05, byte-identical to the frozen template scoring.toml. All five judge.toml files parse and sit in the right suite: gates/render (1 criterion) and gates/constraints (2), both [scoring] aggregation="all_pass" with binary-only criteria; scored/functional (40 binary), scored/polish (6 binary), scored/visual (3 likert, points=5), all aggregation="weighted_mean". Every [judge] block has judge="claude-code" (matches task.toml [verifier.env] REWARDKIT_JUDGE), mode="batched", timeout, isolated=false, prompt_template="prompt.md", and no model, reasoning_effort, temperature or weight key. Every dimension declares the playwright stdio MCP server with the contract args. Only scored/functional/judge.toml:14-18 declares the verifier server: command /usr/local/bin/python3, args ["/tests/tools/restart_mcp.py", "$APP_RESTART_HELPER"], identical to the template header; tests/test.sh exports APP_RESTART_HELPER="$LOG_DIR/app-restart.sh" after chmod 755 and before run_suite gates, and restart_mcp.py:9 reads the helper path from argv[1]. test.sh, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tools/score.py and tools/restart_mcp.py diff clean against the frozen template. Criteria: 52 total, ids unique within each file and across files, name equals id, types only binary or likert, all weights positive (functional 1.0 x13, 1.5 x21, 2.0 x6; others 1.0), all descriptions non-empty, key sets uniform. Prompts resolve: each dimension directory has prompt.md containing both {criteria} and {app_context}; tests/app_context.md exists with Application, Accounts and Key screens sections and no leftover placeholder; test.sh substitutes {app_context} over /tests/*/*/prompt.md. Restart is used consistently: functional/prompt.md:29-31 limits restart_app to the one criterion that names it, and only cw_save_reload_restart (functional/judge.toml:321-326) does. Budgets nest: gates 600+600 < 1500, scored 9000+900+900=10800 < 11100, 1500+11100=12600 < 13200 (task.toml [verifier].timeout_sec). Counterexample attempts: a second criterion calling the single-use restart tool, a model key in a judge.toml, a likert criterion inside a gate, a duplicate id, and a prompt missing {criteria} were each looked for and none exists. Limits of this verdict: it is a source and parser check only. The private check-rubric-schema.py and check-scoring-policy.py were not executed, and no configured RewardKit judge run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index.json covers scripted golden checks only and states the test.sh launch path with uid 65534, env -i and DB_PATH was not measured), so RewardKit actually loading these judge.toml files, expanding $APP_RESTART_HELPER and starting the verifier MCP server is unmeasured and belongs to the runtime evidence records, not to this structural row.
